entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Just as I thought, you like restaurants that[n]have a calm atmosphere.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That aside, there are so many[n]different types of food here.[n]Oh, I'm so excited...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Now, how shall we plan our attack?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes, point taken. The food[n]isn't going anywhere.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I would be more than happy to[n]take that into consideration.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Hm! If that is what you wish,[n]then I must give this my all!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Actually, I often ate at a hotel buffet[n]with my mother...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But to protect my image, she told[n]me what I could and couldn't eat.[n]Those aren't fond memories...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: However, I feel like today's game[n]will prove to be quite fun.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Which of us shall dominate the table?[n]To a fair match.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That was fun.[n]Thank you very much for today.
